title: 51 .t1 re-blesses pair with only 49 .log.bin diffs — the two input_parity goldens have no log.bin sibling in the chunk
evidence:
Boundary enumeration of the chunk (every '^diff --git' line):
49995:diff --git a/goldens/input_parity_draw.t1 b/goldens/input_parity_draw.t1
50030:diff --git a/goldens/input_parity_draw_wide.t1 b/goldens/input_parity_draw_wide.t1
50065:diff --git a/goldens/juice.log.bin b/goldens/juice.log.bin
Extension census of the 102 boundaries: 51 t1, 49 bin, 2 png. Every golden except input_parity_draw and input_parity_draw_wide pairs a .t1 diff with a .log.bin 'Binary files ... differ' stub.
detail: If log.bin files exist at HEAD for the two parity goldens, they too must re-bless (the catalog-hash header shifts in every log) and the '49/49' completeness claim undercounts. If they never had logs, harmless.
recommended_fix: Confirm goldens/input_parity_draw{,_wide}.log.bin do not exist at HEAD; if they do, re-bless them and correct the 49/49 claim to 51/51.
